scope: conceptual derivation only; no implementation, training, QD-DETR modification, or architecture selection
primary_decision: select one first mechanism-isolating intervention family
recommended_formulation: u_w=log(w_sec/1s), w_sec=exp(u_w), w_norm=w_sec/D at the existing attention/evaluation interface
recommended_first_metric: median abs(log(width_stage/GT_width)) and median width/GT for proposals with initial center error <=1s
recommended_falsification: both short bins fail to reduce conditioned final log-width residual and width/GT in a matched pilot, or 20s+ R1@0.7 drops >=5pp without a short-event trajectory gain
claim_boundary: The derivation supports a diagnosis-driven first intervention hypothesis only. It does not establish effectiveness, novelty, causality, or a final paper method.
